description: Nobody sells this under a name. It is described, when it is described at all, by what people have noticed afterwards, and the noticing is always secondhand, always cheerful, and never complete.

overdose.message: Your whole body cramps at once, from the inside out, and something low in you feels wrung dry. It passes. You are fairly sure it passes.

phases.comedown_message: The heaviness fades. Something about it lingers anyway.
phases.end_message: Whatever that was, it's finished with you for now.
phases.peak_message: A deep, unfamiliar heaviness settles low in your gut. Not unpleasant. Not nothing.

effects.take_line: You push the needle in. There is a long, bright, total moment where the world is only that.

withdrawal.message: Everything the syringe was running has gone quiet, and quiet is not the same as rested.

stages.easing: The temperature settles. The ache stays and stops being interesting.
stages.onset: The heaviness low in your gut lifts, and what is left there is not empty so much as switched off.
stages.peak: Hot, then cold, then hot, and your whole middle aches on the inside, where there is nothing in there to have hurt.
stages.rising: Your back aches across the kidneys, and the temperature of the room keeps being wrong in both directions.
stages.tail: Back to yourself. Slightly less of yourself than was advertised, and nothing was ever advertised.

name: grey syringe
